content.title: ETFs That Investors May Consider Amid a Dollar Drag
content.summary: As the dollar weakens and rate-cut bets rise, these ETFs offer investors a way to hedge, diversify and capitalize on opportunities.

content.title: Betting on a Weaker Dollar? ETFs to Consider
content.summary: As the U.S. dollar weakens amid Fed rate cuts and investor caution, ETFs like UDN, CEW and gold-backed funds offer timely hedging opportunities.

content.title: ETFs to Play as Dollar Faces Steep Weekly Drop
content.summary: The greenback faces mounting pressure from Fed rate-cut bets, economic instability and trade concerns, pushing investors toward currency ETFs like CEW and UDN.

content.title: MoneyMasters Podcast 10-2-25- The Hidden Side of the Stock Market's Hot Streak
content.summary: In this episode of the MoneyShow MoneyMasters Podcast, senior alternatives investment strategist Tony Davidow of the Franklin Templeton Institute and managing director Scott Zelniker of UBS-The Zelniker Dorfman Carr & Heritage Group share their insights on the current stock market rally after two years of exceptional gains.

content.title: Market Minute 9-19-25- Behold the "Hedge America" Trade
content.summary: After a day when four major US averages all set records together for the first time since 2021, equity markets are subdued. Gold and silver are flattish, too, while crude oil is down a bit. The dollar and interest rates are rising modestly.

content.title: MoneyMasters Podcast 8-14-25- The Downfall of the US Dollar - Peter Schiff's Prediction
content.summary: In this episode of the MoneyShow MoneyMasters Podcast, Peter Schiff, chief global strategist at Euro Pacific Asset Management, returns with his most urgent warning yet about the US dollar and the bond market.

content.title: The Fed, Gold, and the US Dollar- Where Things Stand
content.summary: The next couple of weeks will certainly be interesting. The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) will decide on whether to lower the federal funds rate (FFR) on July 30. Then on Aug. 1, the US will impose reciprocal tariffs on goods imported from America's trading partners, observes Ed Yardeni, editor of Yardeni QuickTakes.

content.title: Bonus MoneyMasters Podcast- Our Expert Roundtable on Stocks, Rates, Crypto,  Hard Assets
content.summary: The first half of 2025 was a wild ride for investors. After a sharp market drop triggered by tariffs and global turmoil, the S&P 500 roared back with a record-setting 24% rally in just 90 days.

content.title: MoneyMasters Podcast 7-3-25-  Powell, Rates, the Dollar,  the US Economy
content.summary: Stocks are at all-time highs, but the US dollar is slumping and the Federal Reserve under Chair Jay Powell is holding rates steady. Mortgage rates and the housing market also remain stuck, leaving homebuyers and investors guessing.

content.title: Currency ETFs to Watch as the Dollar Struggles
content.summary: The dollar faces its worst first-half since the 1970s as looming Fed cuts and political uncertainty weigh heavily.
